title: feat(leavek1): leave-axis kills k=1 reverse: t=3 vs t=7
science: The forcing negative that kills lambda: on B_6 the same rule gives t(1,0,0)=3, t(1,1,1)=7, so 27<49 and same-k reverse FAILS at k=1.
